symptom: On Mendix 9.x `create published odata service` was refused at write time with `this Mendix 9.24.30 project cannot store ODataPublish$PublishedODataService2.IncludeMetadataByDefault (Mendix 10.8.0+)` (10-odata and 18-folder on 9.24), after the earlier statements of the script were already written
cause: mxcli writes a published OData service as ODataPublish$PublishedODataService2, a document type introduced in 10.4.0; before it the service is Rest$PublishedODataService (deleted 10.4.0), a different document with its own children. The generated version data has no type-level floor, so the property floor could only trip over the first versioned key and named the wrong thing
insight: **Before lowering a refused property, check the type it sits on exists in that version.** Lowering IncludeMetadataByDefault was the obvious fix and would have made it worse: with the floor off, mx check 9.24.30 stops loading the project at all (`TypeCacheUnknownTypeException: The type cache does not contain a type with qualified name ODataPublish$PublishedODataService2`). mendixmodelsdk says it directly: `PublishedODataService2.versionInfo = {introduced: "10.4.0"}`, `rest.PublishedODataService` `deleted: "10.4.0"`. The generated tables carry property floors only, so a whole-type floor has to be a version gate (check-time, MDL-VERSION01, before anything is written) — the same gap lets Workflows$EndOfParallelSplitPathActivity (10.21) through on 9.x. Measured: 10-odata and 18-folder on 9.24 now fail at the gate (no write); on 10.24.24 and 11.13 both PASS. Tests: TestCheckVersionGates_ReportsEveryHandlerGate (published odata on 9.24.30 and 10.3), TestCheckVersionGates_UngatedFormsPass (10.4 passes); mdl-examples/bug-tests/1163-published-odata-below-10-4.mdl
